bandReport.notes: 32 questions, Q35-Q66 contiguous, no gaps. Pages carry printed folios 13-A (p06), 15-A (p07), 17-A (p08), 19-A (p09), 21-A (p10) — the render skips the blank versos, so page-to-page continuity is 40->41, 48->49, 55->56, 60->61 and all are clean. Q35 opens fresh at the head of p06's left column; I checked the tail of p05 (folio 11-A) and it ends with a COMPLETE pendulum potential-energy question (four options (a)-(d), 'The pendulum has same potential energy at all positions.'), so nothing spills into my band from B1. Q66 is complete at the foot of p10's right column; I checked the head of p11 (folio 23-A) and it opens fresh at Q67 (SDG India Index / NITI Aayog), so nothing of mine spills into B3. NO shared Directions/code block anywhere in this band — every question carries its own four options. NON-ASCENDING CODE OPTIONS, each read off the page and re-checked at 9x, not assumed: Q55 (a) 1 only / (b) 2 only / (c) 2 and 3 only / (d) 1, 2 and 3 — there is NO '1 and 2 only'; Q57 (a) 2 and 3 only / (b) 1, 2 and 4 / (c) 1 and 2 only / (d) 3 and 4 only — a 3-item set at (b) sits BEFORE a 2-item set at (c), and there is no all-four option; Q65 (a) 2 and 3 only / (b) 1, 3 and 4 / (c) 1 and 2 only / (d) 1 and 4 only — same shape, no all-four option; Q63 (a) 1 and 2 only / (b) 1, 2 and 4 / (c) 2 and 4 only / (d) 1, 3 and 4 — again no all-four option. Q56 and Q58 DO end at '1, 2, 3 and 4' and are ordinary. Q60 is a 'consider the characteristics' item whose options are soil TYPES, not a code. Q53 and Q59 are 'which pair is not correctly matched' items with the pairings inside the four options (not a List-I/List-II grid), so they are transcribed as 'Term : Meaning' option strings rather than as a pipe table — there is no Match List anywhere in this band. Q37 options are the only math in the band (Celsius-Fahrenheit fractions), verified at 8x: (a) 10/3, (b) 5/9 with +36, (c) 9/5 with +36, (d) 9/5 with +32. One catalog gap reported, on Q59. No printed defects, no missing or duplicated options, no truncated stems seen anywhere in pages 06-10.
